title: Four steps, in order: the clock is part of the problem
caption: Roughly 8 + 15 + 17 + 5 minutes of a 45-minute slot. Each step feeds the next one.

steps.text: Scope (5–8 min): features in and out, the non-functional targets, and a quick estimate. Finish with a one-line summary the interviewer agrees with.
High level (10–15 min): API and data model, then decompose into parts, solve each small, and merge them by node id into one diagram that evolves v1 → v2.
Deep dives (15–20 min): two or three hard parts, each with options, a choice and the reason. This is where the hiring signal is.
Wrap-up (3–5 min): first bottleneck at 10×, failure modes, metrics you would alert on, what you would do next.
